name: npm/context-saver-mcp
title: Context-Saver — MCP Gateway & Multiplexer
description: Connect once, load tools on demand. A single-file, zero-dependency MCP gateway that aggregates dozens of downstream MCP servers while cutting context-window usage by ~90% through lazy tool-schema loading.

tools.name: cs_discover
tools.description: Search the aggregated tool catalog across all configured downstream MCP servers without loading any schemas.

tools.name: cs_plan
tools.description: Inspect a task description and score it against the catalog to recommend the minimal toolset for that turn.

tools.name: cs_load
tools.description: Lazy-load specific downstream tools (full JSON schemas) into the session and announce them via tools/list_changed.

tools.name: cs_unload
tools.description: Unload previously loaded tools to reclaim context.

tools.name: cs_status
tools.description: Show downstream servers, connections, loaded tools and live token-savings accounting.

tools.name: cs_call
tools.description: Invoke any catalog tool directly (auto-loads on demand) without loading its schema first.
